Report on the Committee's study and decision on the matter of reviewing, among the salaries and allowances to be determined by the People's Majlis under Article 102 of the Constitution of the Republic of Maldives, the salary and allowances of the Chief Justice

Report No.: M20/R/ML/2026/12

27 October 2026

Public Accounts Committee

The responsibilities of this Committee include checking whether the various expenditures made by State institutions are made in accordance with what the law permits and in accordance with the budget passed by the Majlis, and checking whether the amounts of money passed by the Majlis are being spent on those purposes. They also include the Committee examining, where State institutions have spent money beyond the authorised amount, the reasons and circumstances that required such spending. Accordingly, in examining matters relating to the State's finances, the responsibilities include studying the financial accounts of State institutions, companies in which the State holds shares, State business enterprises and independent State institutions; studying the various reports of the Auditor General, identifying the measures to be taken and instructing the relevant State institutions. In addition, they include carrying out the matters required in connection with the role the Majlis must play in State borrowing and in the issuing of guarantees by the State; overseeing the work of the Maldives Monetary Authority and the Auditor General's Office; and seeking the advice of other committees in determining the salaries to be determined by the People's Majlis.

1. Introduction

As stated in Article 120(b)(10) of the Rules of Procedure of the People's Majlis, the responsibilities of the Public Accounts Committee include advising the Majlis on determining the salaries and allowances to be determined by the People's Majlis, and seeking the advice of other relevant committees in determining those salaries. Accordingly, this report is the report on the Committee's study and decision on the matter of reviewing, among the salaries and allowances to be determined by the People's Majlis under Article 102 of the Constitution of the Republic of Maldives, the salary and allowances of the Chief Justice. The schedule included in this report forms part of this report.

2. Documents considered by the Committee in studying the matter

In studying this matter, the Committee considered the following reports.

1. "Report on the decision of the Public Accounts Committee on re-reviewing the matter, following the Majlis's return to the Committee of the report submitted to the Majlis, concluded on 26 August 2010, on the Public Accounts Committee's review/formulation of the salary structure to be determined by the People's Majlis under Article 102 of the Constitution and Article 100(a)(10) of the Rules of Procedure of the People's Majlis", passed by the People's Majlis on 28 December 2010;

2. "Report on the decision of the Public Accounts Committee on re-reviewing the salary structure to be determined by the People's Majlis under Article 102 of the Constitution and Article 100(a)(10) of the Rules of Procedure of the People's Majlis" (Report No. މލކ/2012/ރ-10), passed by the People's Majlis on 31 December 2012;

3. "Report on the review and reformulation of the structure of salaries and allowances to be determined by the People's Majlis" (Report No. M19/ML/2024/01), passed by the People's Majlis on 28 February 2024.

4. "Report on the Committee's study and decision on the matter of reviewing, among the salaries and allowances to be determined by the People's Majlis under Article 102 of the Constitution of the Republic of Maldives, the salary and allowances

[signature] [stamp]

of the Speaker of the People's Majlis, the vehicle allowances of members of the Cabinet, and the allowances of island councillors" (Report No. M20/R/ML/2026/11), passed by the Public Accounts Committee of the People's Majlis on 22 October 2026.

3. How the Committee's work proceeded

Since, among those who receive salaries and allowances to be determined by the People's Majlis under Article 102 of the Constitution of the Republic of Maldives, the post of Speaker of the People's Majlis and the post of Chief Justice are posts of the same grade, it was decided unanimously by the members present and voting at the Committee's 26th meeting held on 27 October 2026 that the Public Accounts Committee would take the initiative to deliberate among members on reviewing the salary and allowances of the Chief Justice, in order to equalise the salary of the Speaker of the People's Majlis and the salary of the Chief Justice.

4. How the Committee's deliberations proceeded

At the Committee's 26th meeting held on 27 October 2026, the Committee members deliberated on the following matters.

4.1. Salary and allowances of the Chief Justice

It is noted that the total amount the Chief Justice currently receives as salary and allowances is equal to the salary and allowances received by the Deputy Speaker of the People's Majlis. It is also noted that this salary is lower than the salary of the Speaker of the People's Majlis as re-reviewed by the Public Accounts Committee. Accordingly, the Chief Justice currently receives a total of MVR 91,000 (ninety-one thousand) as salary and allowances. After the Committee's re-review of the salary of the Speaker of the People's Majlis, the Speaker of the People's Majlis will now receive a total of MVR 95,125 (ninety-five thousand one hundred and twenty-five) as salary and allowances. Therefore, in order to arrange for the Chief Justice to receive a salary equal to the salary and allowances of the Speaker

[signature] [stamp]

of the People's Majlis, the Committee decided to review the allowances of the Chief Justice, set a special allowance of MVR 4,125 (four thousand one hundred and twenty-five), and set a total of MVR 95,125 (ninety-five thousand one hundred and twenty-five) as salary and allowances for the Chief Justice. With this change, it is estimated that an additional MVR 49,500 (forty-nine thousand five hundred) per year will be spent on the salary and allowances of the Chief Justice over the current expenditure. 5. Committee's decision

Since, among those who receive salaries and allowances to be determined by the People's Majlis under Article 102 of the Constitution of the Republic of Maldives, the post of Speaker of the People's Majlis and the post of Chief Justice are posts of the same grade, after deliberation at the Public Accounts Committee's 26th meeting of 2026 on reviewing the salary and allowances of the Chief Justice in order to equalise the salary of the Speaker of the People's Majlis and the salary of the Chief Justice, the members present decided unanimously to establish a special allowance for the Chief Justice and to pass it with the change deliberated on and reviewed in the Committee.

[signature] [stamp]

The proposed date for providing the salary and allowances with the change proposed to the salary structure by the People's Majlis is from the day this report is passed on the floor of the People's Majlis.

Therefore, we submit this report to the People's Majlis under Article 120(b)(12) of the Rules of Procedure of the People's Majlis for a decision on this report.
